[SWS_CM_10339] Invoke the registered set/get handlers - polling
⌈
In case a
MethodCallProcessingMode of kPoll has been passed to the constructor of
the ServiceSkeleton (see [SWS_CM_00130]), the deserialized payload contain-
ing the method data (i.e., method ID and input arguments) shall be used to in-
voke a registered SetHandler resp.
GetHandler (see [SWS_CM_00114] and
[SWS_CM_00116]) of the Field class upon a call to the ProcessNextMethodCall
method (see [SWS_CM_00199]) of the ServiceSkeleton class.
⌋
